name: projonatics-mcp

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Return the user the API token belongs to (id, email, role). Use to check auth.

tools.name: list_clients
tools.description: List all clients.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description:
List projects visible to the token's user, with status, dates, contract value and leads.

    Args:
        client_id: Optional client UUID to list only that client's projects.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get full detail for one project (code, client, dates, leads, contract, status).

tools.name: list_milestones
tools.description: List work milestones (delivery phases), optionally for one project.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description:
List tasks with optional filters.

    Args:
        project_id: Project UUID.
        status: Task status: not_started, in_progress, blocked or completed.
        assignee_id: Team-member UUID.
        assigned_to_me: True to return only tasks assigned to the token's user.
        ordering: One of end_date, status, created_at (prefix with - for descending).

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Get one task with assignee, collaborators, dates, blocker info and status.

tools.name: get_project_financials
tools.description:
Financial picture for a project: revenue vs cost summary and margin,
    payment milestones (invoiced/paid/outstanding), and per-team-member cost breakdown.
    Cost/margin figures require an admin-role token.

tools.name: list_payment_milestones
tools.description: List payment milestones (invoicing schedule) across all projects or for one project.

tools.name: get_dashboard
tools.description:
Compact dashboard snapshot: key metrics, operational pulse (on-time, budget, team
    load) and COUNTS per today's-focus group and pending-payment bucket. For the actual
    task / payment lists call get_todays_focus or get_pending_payments (optionally for one
    group), which keeps responses small.

tools.name: get_todays_focus
tools.description:
Tasks needing attention today, grouped: blocked, overdue, due_today, due_this_week,
    ongoing, plus at_risk_projects (over budget or behind schedule). Non-admins see only
    their own tasks. Pass `group` to get just that one list.

    Args:
        group: One of blocked, overdue, due_today, due_this_week, ongoing, at_risk_projects.

tools.name: get_pending_payments
tools.description:
Unpaid payment milestones (admin only) in three buckets: overdue (expected date
    passed), upcoming (due within 7 days) and ready_to_invoice (work milestone completed but
    not yet paid). Pass `bucket` to get just one list.

    Args:
        bucket: One of overdue, upcoming, ready_to_invoice.

tools.name: export_data
tools.description:
Export a dataset as CSV text (admin only) — the same data the app's Export buttons
    download. Datasets: financials (one row per active project), project-financials
    (summary + payment milestones + cost breakdown; needs project_id), workload (allocation
    per active member for a date range) and tasks (filterable). Use it to analyse or
    summarise data, or hand the CSV to the user; for XLSX use the app's Export button.

    Args:
        dataset: financials, project-financials, workload or tasks.
        project_id: Required for project-financials; optional filter for tasks.
        start_date: workload range start (YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today).
        end_date: workload range end (YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today + 6 days).
        status: tasks filter: not_started, in_progress, blocked or completed.
        assignee_id: tasks filter: team-member UUID.

tools.name: get_alerts
tools.description:
Current alerts grouped as overdue_tasks, upcoming_milestones, overdue_payments,
    budget_warnings and ready_to_invoice. overdue_tasks and upcoming_milestones are scoped
    to the token owner (their assigned tasks / the projects they have tasks on), not the
    whole company; use get_dashboard for company-wide overdue/blocked/unassigned counts.
    Archived projects are excluded everywhere.

tools.name: list_team_members
tools.description: List team members with role, allocation and active flag (salary visible to admins).

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description:
Estimate the cost of putting N engineers on a project for N working days,
    using the project's manday rate. Read-only computation. Admin only.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description:
Create a task under a work milestone. Returns the created task.

    Args:
        milestone_id: Work-milestone UUID the task belongs to (required; get it from list_milestones).
        title: Task title.
        description: Optional longer description.
        assignee_id: Team-member UUID to assign.
        collaborator_ids: Team-member UUIDs collaborating on the task.
        start_date: YYYY-MM-DD.
        end_date: YYYY-MM-DD, must be on or after start_date.
        status: not_started (default), in_progress, blocked or completed.
        task_type: in_scope (default) or goodwill.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description:
Update fields on a task (only supplied fields change). Use for status changes,
    reassignment, blocking with a note, rescheduling, or moving to another milestone.

    Args:
        task_id: Task UUID.
        title: New title.
        description: New description.
        status: not_started, in_progress, blocked or completed.
        blocker_note: Why the task is blocked (set together with status=blocked).
        assignee_id: Team-member UUID; pass '' to unassign.
        collaborator_ids: Replaces the whole collaborator list.
        start_date: YYYY-MM-DD; pass '' to clear.
        end_date: YYYY-MM-DD; pass '' to clear.
        task_type: in_scope or goodwill.
        milestone_id: Move the task to this work-milestone UUID.

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description:
Permanently delete a task. DESTRUCTIVE and cannot be undone: confirm with the
    user first, then call with confirm=true.

    Args:
        task_id: Task UUID.
        confirm: Must be true to proceed.

tools.name: create_milestone
tools.description:
Create a work milestone (delivery phase) on a project. A paired payment milestone
    with the same name is created automatically; `amount` sets its invoice amount.
    Milestone status is derived from its tasks and cannot be set directly.

    Args:
        project_id: Project UUID.
        name: Milestone name (shared with its payment milestone).
        description: Optional description.
        due_date: YYYY-MM-DD.
        sequence: Ordering position (integer).
        amount: Invoice amount for the paired payment milestone, as a decimal string.

tools.name: update_milestone
tools.description:
Update a work milestone (only supplied fields change). Renaming also renames the
    paired payment milestone; `amount` updates its invoice amount. Milestone status is
    derived from its tasks (all completed -> completed, all not_started -> not_started,
    otherwise in_progress): change task statuses instead.

    Args:
        milestone_id: Work-milestone UUID.
        name: New name.
        description: New description.
        due_date: YYYY-MM-DD; pass '' to clear.
        sequence: Ordering position.
        amount: Invoice amount as a decimal string.

tools.name: delete_milestone
tools.description:
Permanently delete a work milestone. DESTRUCTIVE: this also deletes ALL of its
    tasks and its paired payment milestone (the invoice line), and cannot be undone.
    Confirm with the user first, then call with confirm=true.

    Args:
        milestone_id: Work-milestone UUID.
        confirm: Must be true to proceed.

tools.name: create_client
tools.description:
Create a client. Admin only.

    Args:
        name: Client name (contact or organisation).
        email: Contact email.
        phone: Contact phone.
        company: Company name.

tools.name: update_client
tools.description: Update a client's contact details (only supplied fields change). Admin only.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description:
Create a project under a client. The project code is generated by the server.
    Admin only.

    Args:
        client_id: Client UUID (from list_clients).
        name: Project name.
        description: Optional description.
        start_date: YYYY-MM-DD.
        end_date: YYYY-MM-DD.
        status: "Active" (default), "On hold" or "Completed" (exact casing).
        project_type: fixed_price (default), retainer or time_and_materials.
        project_category: strategic, commercial or support.
        manday_rate: Decimal string; overrides the company default rate for cost calculations.
        budget: Decimal string.
        tech_lead_id: Active team-member UUID.
        first_responder_id: Active team-member UUID.
        execution_lead_id: Active team-member UUID.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description:
Update a project (only supplied fields change). Use archive_project to archive.
    Changing manday_rate is recorded in the rate history and recomputes project cost.
    Admin only.

    Args:
        project_id: Project UUID.
        name: New name.
        description: New description.
        start_date: YYYY-MM-DD; pass '' to clear.
        end_date: YYYY-MM-DD; pass '' to clear.
        status: "Active", "On hold" or "Completed" (exact casing).
        project_type: fixed_price, retainer or time_and_materials.
        project_category: strategic, commercial or support.
        manday_rate: Decimal string; pass '' to clear the override.
        budget: Decimal string; pass '' to clear.
        tech_lead_id: Active team-member UUID; pass '' to clear.
        first_responder_id: Active team-member UUID; pass '' to clear.
        execution_lead_id: Active team-member UUID; pass '' to clear.

tools.name: archive_project
tools.description:
Archive a project (hides it from active lists; nothing is deleted), or
    un-archive with archived=false. Prefer this over delete_project. Admin only.

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description:
Permanently delete a project. DESTRUCTIVE: this also deletes ALL of its work
    milestones, their tasks and every payment milestone (the invoicing schedule), and
    cannot be undone. Prefer archive_project unless the user explicitly wants the data
    gone. Confirm with the user first, then call with confirm=true. Admin only.

    Args:
        project_id: Project UUID.
        confirm: Must be true to proceed.

tools.name: delete_client
tools.description:
Permanently delete a client. DESTRUCTIVE and cannot be undone. The API refuses
    (409) while the client still has projects: delete or reassign those first.
    Confirm with the user first, then call with confirm=true. Admin only.

    Args:
        client_id: Client UUID.
        confirm: Must be true to proceed.

tools.name: update_payment_milestone
tools.description:
Update a payment milestone's name, amount or expected (invoice) date. Payment
    milestones are created and deleted together with their work milestone; use
    mark_payment_received to record payment. Admin only.

    Args:
        payment_milestone_id: Payment-milestone UUID (from list_payment_milestones).
        name: New name (also renames the paired work milestone).
        amount: Decimal string, >= 0.
        expected_date: YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: mark_payment_received
tools.description:
Record that a payment milestone was paid (or reverse it with received=false).
    Admin only.

    Args:
        payment_milestone_id: Payment-milestone UUID.
        received_date: YYYY-MM-DD the payment was received (required when received=true).
        received: false to mark the milestone as not received again.

tools.name: plan_project
tools.description:
Create a whole project plan in ONE call: the project, its work milestones (each with
    its paired payment milestone) and their tasks, atomically — if anything is invalid
    nothing is created and the error names the exact item (milestones.1.tasks.0.end_date).
    Prefer this over create_project + create_milestone + create_task chains. Admin only.

    Args:
        client_id: Client UUID (from list_clients).
        name: Project name.
        milestones: List of {name, due_date?, amount?, description?, sequence?, tasks?}.
            `amount` is the invoice amount (decimal string) of the paired payment milestone;
            `sequence` defaults to the position. Each task is {title, description?,
            assignee_id?, collaborator_ids?, start_date?, end_date?, status?, task_type?}.
        description, start_date, end_date, status, project_type, project_category,
        manday_rate, budget, tech_lead_id, first_responder_id, execution_lead_id:
            Same meaning as in create_project.

tools.name: reschedule_project
tools.description:
Shift a whole project in time by N days (negative = earlier): project start/end,
    every milestone due date, every task start/end and the expected date of every payment
    milestone not yet received. Received payments keep their dates. Every change is
    audit-logged. Returns how many of each were shifted. Admin only.

    Args:
        project_id: Project UUID.
        shift_days: Non-zero integer between -365 and 365.

tools.name: create_team_member
tools.description:
Add a team member. If no user with this email exists, one is created with the
    'viewer' login role (login roles are managed by an admin, not through this tool).
    Admin only.

    Args:
        email: Login email of the person.
        job_title: Free-text position, e.g. "Backend Engineer".
        monthly_salary: Decimal string; used for cost calculations.
        display_name: Name shown in the app (defaults to the email).

tools.name: update_team_member
tools.description:
Update a team member's display name, job title or monthly salary (only supplied
    fields change). Email cannot be changed here. Admin only.

tools.name: deactivate_team_member
tools.description:
Deactivate a team member (keeps history, hides them from assignment lists), or
    reactivate with active=true. Team members are not deleted. Admin only.

instructions: Projonatics is a project-management and financial-tracking platform for a software consulting team. Use these tools to read and update clients, projects, work milestones, tasks, payment milestones, costs/margins, dashboard metrics and alerts. IDs are UUIDs; get them from the list_* tools first. Money is in the company currency (pass amounts as decimal strings); dates are ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Task statuses: not_started, in_progress, blocked, completed. Work-milestone status is derived from its tasks, so change task statuses instead. get_dashboard returns counts only; use get_todays_focus / get_pending_payments for the lists and export_data for CSV extracts. Write tools (create_*, update_*, archive_project, mark_payment_received, deactivate_team_member) change live data and are recorded in the audit log under the token owner's name. plan_project creates a project with all its milestones and tasks in one call; reschedule_project shifts every date on a project. delete_task, delete_milestone, delete_project and delete_client are permanent (project delete cascades to milestones, tasks and payment milestones; prefer archive_project): confirm with the user before calling them with confirm=true.
